items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1989-08-13
items.q: The interviewee narrates a story involving Louie Armstrong, Punch Miller, and Lucille, but does not describe a personal relationship with Lucille herself.

ctx.x: And, uh, Louie got off the plane and he saw Punch in the crowd. So, he told Lucille, he said, I gotta go in with the first limousine, but you stay here and you make sure that Punch comes to the party tonight at the Royal Orleans where they were having it. Uh-huh. And so she stayed behind and Louie went on. Now, I, I didn't go out to meet him and as a matter of fact, I didn't plan to go to the concert either because I didn't want to get into all that action. I didn't care much for hearing Louie in concert. Uh-huh.…
